records.title: Security Incident Update #2
records.summary: Binance states unauthorized withdrawals began around 2026-10-29 20:05 UTC and estimates approximately $6.3B in losses. It says more than $6.34B in company funds has been set aside, including $5B in the exact impacted token assets, and that it is buying the remaining relevant token assets through market and OTC channels. It reports approximately $3B frozen on-chain, withdrawals temporarily suspended, an initial post-incident Proof of Reserves snapshot planned within 12 hours, results expected by 2026-11-02, and further technical findings expected within about 48 hours.
records.limitations: Company statement, not an independent audit. The announcement examples list USDC, USDT, BTC, ETH and BNB but do not disclose XRP-specific quantity, acquisition trades, reserve wallet addresses or completed XRP replenishment. Additional breach points remain under investigation.

records.title: North Korea Steals USD 6.36 Billion From Binance in the Largest Hack in History
records.summary: TRM reports approximately $6.36B transferred from Binance-attributed wallets across ten blockchains, mostly within about 20 minutes beginning 20:05 UTC on Oct 29. Five Binance-labelled XRPL wallets sent 233.46M XRP to one attacker address between 20:05 and 20:09 UTC. TRM reports about $2.67B in stablecoins frozen by Tether, Circle, Ripple and World Liberty Financial, plus about $30M in ETH/ARB moved by Arbitrum Security Council. It confirms 40.5M RLUSD frozen by Ripple on-chain, 825M USDC by Circle and approximately 1.77B USDT by Tether. TRM attributes the attack to TraderTraitor with high confidence, based on on-chain and off-chain intelligence.
records.limitations: TRM's attribution is a high-confidence third-party intelligence assessment, not a public law-enforcement finding. Its fund-location snapshot is as of 2026-10-30 00:30 UTC; the reported 233.46M XRP remaining at the receiver is stale for a 2026-10-31 cutoff. Frozen is not recovered. TRM's USD valuation is transfer-time marked.

records.title: Freezing Tokens
records.summary: XRPL documentation states issuers can freeze issued trust-line tokens, but this does not apply to native XRP. XRP has no issuer and cannot be frozen by an issuer; native XRP is tracked in accounts rather than issued-token trust lines.
records.limitations: Protocol-level issuer freeze limits do not prevent custodial exchanges from restricting customer accounts, courts or law enforcement from acting against custodians, or a holder from voluntarily transferring assets.

records.title: XRP Liquidation Heatmap — 2026-10-31 04:24 UTC
records.summary: At 04:24 UTC Oct 31, Alpha displayed XRP spot $1.2466, all-venue open interest $2.81B and 24-hour volume $2.20B. It reported $1.7M long and $1.3M short liquidations in 24 hours. Modelled liquidation clusters were $6.2M of shorts near $1.2633 and $4.2M of longs near $1.2255.
records.limitations: Open-interest coverage is not reconciled with Liqwall. Liquidation heatmap levels are modelled from open interest and standard leverage tiers, not confirmed account-level liquidation prices. Aggregated provider values are not admitted as model features.

records.title: XRP Liquidations, Funding and Open Interest — 2026-10-31 04:12 UTC
records.summary: At 04:12 UTC Oct 31, Liqwall displayed XRP near $1.25, all-exchange open interest $1.32B (+0.2% over 24h), $3.1M 24-hour liquidations ($1.8M longs, $1.3M shorts), average funding +0.0066% per eight hours, Binance funding +0.0100%, and 72.9% of Binance XRP-position accounts long.
records.limitations: Its open-interest universe differs materially from Alpha's. Account ratios are not notional exposure. Provider methodology and venue coverage must be preserved; no composite OI value is calculated.

records.title: XRP ETF flows — Friday October 30, 2026, partial T+1
records.summary: The dashboard reports a preliminary $0.7M net outflow for XRP ETFs on Friday Oct 30, with only two of five funds reported; three funds remained outstanding at capture.
records.limitations: Partial T+1 data. Do not treat -$0.7M as the final daily flow or as a complete five-fund measure.

records.title: Proof of Reserves
records.summary: The official page exposes a Download All Address control and describes proof-of-reserves ownership verification for both hot and cold wallets, customer balance snapshots, Merkle-tree liabilities and zk-SNARK verification. Binance's Oct 30 incident update says a new post-incident snapshot is planned, with results expected by Nov 2.
records.limitations: The rendered page extraction does not expose the current address export or a post-incident XRP reserve ratio. PoR is a dated asset/liability snapshot and does not by itself prove intraday liquidity, absence of encumbrances or token-specific replenishment trades.
